title: Photometric Classification of 2315 Pan-STARRS1 Supernovae with Superphot (Hosseinzadeh et al. 2020)

episodes.description: Classify one spectroscopically unclassified PS1-MDS transient with Superphot from its griz light curve and host redshift

chain.op: restrict to points between -50 and +180 d of discovery
MCMC fit of Eq.1 (6 params + intrinsic scatter) per filter, PyMC3 Metropolis-Hastings, 25 chains
sum per-filter posteriors as prior for second iteration
average observed-filter posteriors for unobserved filters
draw 10 model light curves from posterior
convert fluxes to luminosity with host redshift, MW extinction, K-correction 1+z
project onto training-set PCA (6 components) + peak absolute magnitude per filter; rescale
apply RF to 10 feature sets, average probabilities, adopt max
publish classification, confidence, reduced chi2 and R-hat in Table 3

episodes.description: Determine the host-galaxy redshift of one transient from its host spectrum (RVSAO cross-correlation with visual inspection)

chain.op: cross-correlate host spectrum with 16 galaxy templates in RVSAO
exclude spectra with all RCC<4 and single matches 4<RCC<5
visually inspect ~600 spectra meeting 3 mismatch criteria; verify or determine redshift manually, else exclude
supplement with public catalog redshifts (1 arcsec); manually inspect conflicts
exclude 199 transients variable across seasons

episodes.description: Implement V19 method as open-source Superphot, choose modifications, validate by LOO CV, study confidence thresholds, compare to other classifiers, apply to 2315 transients

chain.op: assemble training set (557 SNe) and test set (2315)
model fitting with modified priors
PCA feature extraction
MVG oversampling to 1000 per class
RF classification
leave-one-out cross-validation and confusion matrices
class-fraction correction check
confidence-threshold analysis
agreement with V20 and Jones et al. 2017 classifiers
rare-class and AGN checks
hyperparameter grid and alternative classifiers (Appendix D)

notes: All 1795 layout lines read (24 pages incl. appendices and references); layout text contains full body text for all pages, so raw .txt was not needed (raw is longer because figure tick labels expand). Per-object human branches occur in redshift determination (SP-B01..B03) and post-hoc diagnoses (SP-B05, SP-B16, SP-B17); model-family choice per object is absent (every object gets the same model). Fit-quality statistics are reported but not used to reject fits.
